allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on September 10, 2026 for consideration and approval of the proposal for Issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) / Bonds / other instruments on private placement basis.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates regarding intimation of receipt of Listing approval from BSE limited for 3164557 equity shares on preferential basis
